user.title: Add a public shared album
user.description: Paste the album's public link from Photos: open the shared album, tap the people icon, turn on Public Website and copy the link. Both photos.icloud.com/shared/album/… and older icloud.com/sharedalbum/#… links work. Anyone with the link can see the album, so treat it like a password.

data_description.url: The link Photos gives you for the album's Public Website.
data_description.name: Optional. Leave empty to use the album's own name.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only needed if Apple answers from a host this integration doesn't know yet.

data_description.extra_trusted_hosts: Host names Apple uses for this album, like p99-ckdatabasews.icloud.com. *.example.com matches subdomains.

settings.title: Where and how to save {album}
settings.description: {album} has {photos} photos and {videos} videos right now. You can change every setting later from the integration's options or the Shared Album Mgmt sidebar.

data.leave_mode: When a photo leaves the album

data_description.photo_format: Convert HEIC to JPEG and Keep originals take the largest version Apple has. Apple's smaller JPEG is about 2048 pixels wide and much smaller.
data_description.leave_mode: Quarantine moves the file aside so you can restore or delete it from the sidebar. Nothing is removed until a first full read of the album, or when Apple returns an empty album.

reconfigure.title: Change the album link
reconfigure.description: Paste a new public link for this album, or change its name.

data_description.url: The link Photos gives you for the album's Public Website.

init.title: Album settings
init.description: Saving reloads the album. Files already downloaded stay where they are unless a setting below removes them.

data_description.interval_minutes: 0 syncs only when you ask (Sync now button or action).

data.leave_mode: When a photo leaves the album

data_description.photo_format: Convert HEIC to JPEG and Keep originals take the largest version Apple has. Apple's smaller JPEG is about 2048 pixels wide and much smaller.
data_description.leave_mode: Quarantine moves the file aside so you can restore or delete it from the sidebar. Nothing is removed until a first full read of the album, or when Apple returns an empty album.

data_description.media_dir: Home Assistant media folder to save into. The album appears under Media > My media.
data_description.folder: Folder inside the media folder. Changing it starts a new folder; the old one is left as it is.
data_description.write_latest: A copy of the newest photo, for picture cards.
data_description.write_index: A list of every file with its date and size, for custom dashboards.

data_description.keep_days: Only keep photos taken in the last this many days. 0 keeps all.
data_description.max_files: Only keep the newest this many items. 0 keeps all.
data_description.min_file_size_kb: Skip items smaller than this. 0 keeps all.
data_description.min_long_edge: Skip items narrower than this on their longer side. 0 keeps all.

data_description.extra_trusted_hosts: Apple hosts to allow besides the built-in ones, for when Apple starts using a new host. Use *.example.com for every subdomain.
data_description.max_concurrent_downloads: How many files download at the same time.
data_description.min_free_space_mb: A sync stops before downloading when it would leave less free space than this.
data_description.jpeg_quality: Quality of JPEGs converted from HEIC.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Syncs an album now, in the background.

full.name: Check every file
full.description: Also re-read every downloaded file and download again any that changed or went missing.

rebuild_index.name: Rebuild index
rebuild_index.description: Forgets files that were deleted by hand and rewrites index.json and latest.jpg, without contacting Apple.

config_entry_id.name: Album
config_entry_id.description: The album whose quarantine to empty.

older_than_days.name: Older than
older_than_days.description: Only delete files quarantined at least this many days ago. 0 deletes all.

confirm.title: Trust {host}?
confirm.description: Syncing {album} stopped because Apple returned {host}, which isn't one of the Apple hosts this integration knows. If the host ends in icloud.com or icloud-content.com it is almost certainly Apple's. Submit to add it to the album's extra trusted hosts and sync again.

abort.invalid_host: That host name can't be added.

heic_unavailable.title: HEIC photos can't be converted
heic_unavailable.description: The pillow-heif library couldn't be loaded on this system, so albums set to Convert HEIC to JPEG are saving Apple's largest JPEG instead (or the HEIC original when Apple has no JPEG). Check the log for the import error, or switch those albums to Apple's smaller JPEG.

low_disk_space.title: {album}: not enough disk space
low_disk_space.description: Syncing {album} stopped before downloading because only {free} MB is free and {needed} MB is needed (including the space the album keeps free). Free up space, or lower Keep this much disk free in the album's Advanced settings.

album_gone.title: {album} can't be read
album_gone.description: Apple no longer shares {album} publicly: its Public Website was turned off or the album was deleted. Files already downloaded are kept. Turn Public Website back on, change the link with Reconfigure, or remove the album.

public_folder.title: {album}'s photos can be downloaded without a login
public_folder.description: {album} saves its photos in {folder}, inside the www folder. Home Assistant serves everything in www at /local/ to anyone who can reach it, without asking anyone to log in. Open the album's Settings in Shared Album Mgmt and move it to a media folder, such as shared_albums. The album keeps syncing until you do.

invalid_folder_setup.message: The album's {field} setting isn't usable. Open the album's options and choose a media folder and folder again.

unknown_album.message: That isn't a Shared Album Mgmt album.

album_not_loaded.message: That album isn't running. Check it on the integration page.
